cases.label: SUPPORTED

A filename enumerated from the checked-out pages directory is interpolated into a shell command without escaping; a repository filename containing shell syntax can alter the git command.

cases.label: SUPPORTED
review_reasons: The URLSession challenge handler accepts any present serverTrust, sets its current exceptions, and returns a trust credential without pinning or checking the challenged host's certificate identity.

cases.label: SUPPORTED

cases.label: UNCLEAR

missing_premises: Intended trust boundary and deployment/use of Mimt are not established by this source span.
